I couldn't assign PAL-6076 to bay A-03, and I made no assignment.

I selected PAL-6076 in the "Pallet to place" dropdown. The bay map is a canvas element with no bay labels in the page. My tools can only click the canvas as a whole, not at a chosen spot on it. Three attempts to click it left "Selected bay" showing "none".

One of my later clicks hit the Orders link in the sidebar by mistake, so the browser is no longer on the Warehouse page. That click only navigated away. It didn't change any records.
